spec.description: Albumary operations, user activity, and diagnostics in one dashboard.

spec.title: Syncs completed
spec.description: Completed per-user syncs during the selected time range.

spec.title: Recent requests
spec.description: Matched route templates only; raw URLs and query strings are excluded.

options.content: **Counts show structured log events in the selected time range, not live service health.** Earlier plain-text logs are excluded; development may contain simulated validation failures.

spec.title: Sync failures
spec.description: Failed per-user sync attempts during the selected time range.

spec.title: Imports completed
spec.description: Completed jobs may still contain partial or review candidates.

spec.title: Import failures
spec.description: Failed import attempts; a later resume may succeed.

spec.title: Import stage totals
spec.description: Total elapsed stage time in the selected range. Matching includes grouping; stages may overlap across concurrent imports.

spec.expr: sum by (stage) (sum_over_time({app="albumary",environment="$environment"} | json | event="import_stage_completed" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Warnings and failures
spec.description: Broad catch-all for structured warnings and errors, including events outside the diagnostic categories below.

spec.title: Recent Spotify syncs
spec.description: Open an event to inspect run ID, phase, counts, and duration.

spec.expr: {app="albumary",environment="$environment"} | json | __error__="" | event=~"spotify_sync_(completed|failed)|spotify_recent_plays_page_full" | line_format `{{.event}}{{if .user_id}}  user={{.user_id}}{{end}}{{if .tracks_fetched}}  tracks={{.tracks_fetched}}{{end}}{{if .completed_albums}}  albums={{.completed_albums}}{{end}}{{if .sync_phase}}  phase={{.sync_phase}}{{end}}{{if .failure_category}}  category={{.failure_category}}{{end}}{{if .status_code}}  status={{.status_code}}{{end}}`

spec.title: Recent imports and outcomes
spec.description: Candidate scope identifies resume subsets. A completed job may still have review or partial candidates.

spec.title: API response status
spec.description: Request events grouped by HTTP status. Counts depend on the selected interval.

options.content: **Observed changes, not an audit trail or a count of distinct people.** Production logs are retained for 30 days; development logs for 3 days. Profile names and album titles are historical snapshots. Filter by a validation run ID to isolate simulated activity.

spec.title: Activity by event
spec.description: Number of observed user actions by event type in the selected time range.

spec.title: Recent user activity
spec.description: Observed changes with profile and album snapshots, rating, tags, and validation marker. Expand a line for its raw fields. Note text is never logged.

spec.expr: {app="albumary",environment="$environment",service="api"} |= `${activity_filter}` | json | __error__="" | event=~"album_manually_added|album_removed|album_listen_added|album_listen_removed|album_rating_changed|album_rating_removed|album_note_changed|album_note_removed|album_tags_changed" | json added_tags="added_tags", removed_tags="removed_tags" | line_format `{{.event}}  profile={{.profile_slug}} ({{.user_id}})  album={{.album_artist}} - {{.album_title}}{{if .rating}}  rating={{.rating}}{{end}}{{if .change}}  change={{.change}}{{end}}{{if .listened_at}}  listened_at={{.listened_at}}{{end}}{{if .added_tags}}  added={{.added_tags}}{{end}}{{if .removed_tags}}  removed={{.removed_tags}}{{end}}{{if .validation_run_id}}  [{{.validation_run_id}}]{{end}}`

options.content: **Investigate what went wrong.** Counts are observed events in the selected time range, not a live health check. Select an environment above; use the diagnostic filter to isolate a validation run. Standalone maintenance commands are not collected by default.

spec.title: External services
spec.description: Exhausted requests and Spotify catalog fallbacks. Sync failures remain in Recent Spotify syncs. Counts event records, not unique incidents.

spec.title: Metadata & artwork
spec.description: Manual lookup fallbacks, failed refreshes, and artwork failures. Counts event records, not unique incidents.

spec.title: Database & jobs
spec.description: Database errors and failed maintenance observed in collected streams; standalone commands are not collected by default. Counts event records, not unique incidents.

spec.title: Access & connections
spec.description: Sign-in, ownership, and Spotify connection failures. No email addresses or tokens are shown. Counts event records, not unique incidents.
